text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The study is a non-review research paper that uses a deforestation projection as an input alongside climate change scenarios to model future habitat suitability for the woolly monkey in Colombia. While it includes national-scale spatial analysis and evaluates multiple future scenarios, its primary focus is on species distribution modeling and conservation assessment—not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction itself. The deforestation layer is adopted from an external projection rather than generated by the authors as a core LULC modeling effort. Thus, LULC change (deforestation) is used incidentally as a constraint in species distribution modeling, not as the central research objective. The paper meets none of the exclusion criteria but does not satisfy the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus be LULC prediction.)
